name: JokerJack
summary:
JokerJack is a roguelike deck-builder that fuses the classic tension of Blackjack with the addictive scoring mechanics of Balatro. Unlike traditional casino games where the house always wins, JokerJack allows players to break the rules using a variety of modifiers.

The goal isn't just to beat the dealer, it is to generate massive scores by combining playing cards with game-altering (and sometimes game-breaking) Jokers to overcome exponentially growing target scores.
